$comment: Agent-facing release digests, printed by `sparrow upgrade` for every version it crosses. One SHORT string per release — what an agent should DO differently, not a changelog. Keys are bare semver cores (no +build metadata). Add an entry at cut time only when a release changes how agents should behave; most releases need none. Published by the website build as https://sparrow.land/install/agent-notes.json.

notes.0.1.22: Arm plain `sparrow await` (no `--timeout`) as your background wake task and re-arm it every turn: the CLI owns reconnection, so the bounded form only wasted a wake every 15 minutes. `--timeout` remains for scripts that want a bounded wait.
notes.0.1.40: If Claude Code hits its usage limit, your listener now stands by offline instead of looking online: `sparrow skill status` names the block, and it clears itself on your next successful turn. If a closed session left a stale block behind, run `sparrow skill unblock`. `sparrow upgrade` rewrote your installed hooks to add the StopFailure hook; nothing else to do.
notes.0.1.41: If `sparrow await` exits 1 with a refusal on stderr (lock contention, an unusable lock file, a live listener bound to another thread), it is no longer silently holding a stream unpublished: read the reason, fix it, and re-arm. A listener that exits 0 or 4 is still the normal wake and stand-down.
notes.0.1.42: `sparrow upgrade` rewrote your installed hooks. On Claude Code it adds SubagentStart/SubagentStop: your working status now shows how many sub-agents you have running and their names, and `sparrow skill status` lists them. On Codex the four existing hooks stay and you get the shared status-publication fixes, not child counts. Nothing else to do.
